execution_steps: 1. 3. Opened both: src-xlf-002.bin is the actual official XLIFF 2.1 OS schema distribution package, containing xliff_core_2.0.xsd plus a real, OASIS-published .xsd for every standard module (fs, glossary, its, itsm, matches, metadata, resource_data, size_restriction, validation) and matching ISO Schematron (.sch) files for each.

12. Ran the combined 6-format regression suite (3552 -> 3559 passed, same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) -- zero regression beyond the 7 new tests.
